simple_explanation: Your chest X-ray shows you have pneumonia in your right lung. Pneumonia is an infection that causes inflammation in your lung. The infected area shows up as a white patch on the X-ray. This is called community-acquired pneumonia because you got it outside the hospital.
important_instructions: Take amoxicillin-clavulanate 875/125 mg twice daily for exactly 7 days. Drink plenty of fluids throughout the day. Use a humidifier or breathe steam from a hot shower. Come back immediately if you have trouble breathing, chest pain, or fever above 101°F.
medication_guidance: This antibiotic fights the bacteria causing your pneumonia. Take it with food to prevent stomach upset. Finish all the pills even if you feel better. Don't save any leftover medication. Side effects may include diarrhea or yeast infections.
follow_up: If you're not feeling better in 3 days, come back to see us. We may need to try a different antibiotic or do more tests. Most people start feeling better within 48-72 hours of starting treatment.
